verified_facts.text: Miraval Austin is located in the Balcones Canyonlands Preserve in the Texas Hill Country.
verified_facts.excerpt: And because we’re located in the Balcones Canyonlands Preserve, this pristine natural environment is guaranteed by law to stay that way.

verified_facts.text: Of the resort's 220-plus acres, 170 will never be developed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Of Miraval Austin’s 220-plus acres, 170 will never be developed.

verified_facts.text: Endangered golden-cheeked warblers nest on the property each year.
verified_facts.excerpt: That means endangered birds like the golden-cheeked warbler, which nest here (and only here) each year, can continue to make our oasis their own.

verified_facts.text: Architects, designers and chefs chose each detail in alignment with the culture of Austin, Texas.
verified_facts.excerpt: From our architects to our designers to our chefs, our team consciously chose each detail in alignment not just with Miraval’s mission, but with the vibrant culture of Texas’ creative capital.

verified_facts.text: All rooms have private balconies with Hill Country views, and some overlook Lake Travis.
verified_facts.excerpt: The serene, restful rooms all have private balconies with Hill Country views. Some overlook Lake Travis, a manmade lake that's popular with boaters.

verified_facts.text: Rooms include meditation cushions, singing Tibetan bowls, plush robes and slippers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Other thoughtful details include slate tilework, full-size amenities, meditation cushions, singing Tibetan bowls, plush robes and slippers

verified_facts.text: Miraval is a digital device-free environment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Miraval is a digital device-free environment.

verified_facts.text: Tidal Flow, a couples aquatic journey, is a spa treatment exclusive to Miraval Austin.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Miraval Austin Exclusive

Aqua Bodywork

Tidal Flow: Couples Aquatic Journey

verified_facts.text: The spa entryway is lined with stone walls, wood-beamed ceilings and mandalas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stone walls, wood-beamed ceilings, and mandalas line the entryway, evoking nature’s elements with spiritual symbols.

verified_facts.text: The property has two infinity pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: including our main restaurant, two infinity pools, the Life in Balance Spa

verified_facts.text: Spa appointments fill up quickly, and 4-6 week advance reservations are strongly recommended.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spa appointments fill up quickly, and last-minute spa availability cannot be guaranteed. 4-6 week advance reservations are strongly recommended.

verified_facts.text: The on-site Cypress Creek Farm provides produce and eggs for guests' meals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meet our farmers to explore our on-site farm that provides produce and eggs for your daily meals at Miraval.

verified_facts.text: Quantum Leap on the Blue Heron Challenge Course is a leap from a 25-foot pole.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expand the boundaries of your comfort zone and relearn trust with a leap from a 25-foot pole.

verified_facts.text: The amenities include an equine center, cooking and cocktail classes, and an onsite farm.
verified_facts.excerpt: two pools, cooking and cocktail classes, an equine center, and an onsite farm.

verified_facts.text: Packages include all meals, snacks, coffee, smoothies and non-alcoholic beverages.
verified_facts.excerpt: That's right, all meals, snacks, coffee, smoothies, and non-alcoholic beverages are included

verified_facts.text: Miraval is a gratuity-free resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: No tips needed. Miraval is a gratuity-free resort

verified_facts.text: Miraval welcomes guests who are 18 or older.
verified_facts.excerpt: Miraval welcomes guests who are 18+ years old.

verified_facts.text: Packages include a shared shuttle from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Shared shuttle from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport.

verified_facts.text: The resort is not a jumping-off point to explore Austin; guests come and stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: This isn't exactly a jumping-off point to explore Austin—you get here and stay here

verified_facts.text: A guided Preserve Hike covers two miles in the Balcones Canyonlands Preserve with 250 feet of elevation gain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore rolling hills with occasional brief, steeper sections and an overall elevation gain of 250 feet covering two miles for a great introduction to the local Balcones Canyonlands Preserve.
